issues.issue: Whether the respondents obtained Romanian passports voluntarily and intending to use them
issues.applicant_position: Passports obtained voluntarily and used to travel, showing intent to avail themselves of Romania.
issues.respondent_position: Passports obtained only to ease travel to Ireland, then left there; no intent to re-avail.
issues.result_text: Respondents obtained passports voluntarily and intended to use them, not merely for convenience.

issues.issue: Whether the presumption of intent from holding a national passport was rebutted
issues.applicant_position: Holding a national passport presumes intent to avail oneself of protection under the UNHCR Handbook.
issues.respondent_position: Passports were used only for travel to Ireland; the presumption is rebutted.
issues.result_text: Respondents failed to rebut the presumption of intent to re-avail themselves of Romanian protection.

issues.issue: Whether refugee protection should cease under IRPA subsection 108(2)
issues.applicant_position: Refugee protection should cease because the respondents re-availed themselves of Romanian protection.
issues.respondent_position: Respondents deny any voluntary re-availment of protection.
issues.result_text: Application to cease refugee protection allowed; protection ceased and the claims are rejected.

issues.issue: Whether the hearing could proceed despite the absence of some respondents
issues.applicant_position: Notices were sent and the hearing was rescheduled after postponements.
issues.result_text: Hearing proceeded after notices and postponements; absent respondents did not seek another adjournment.
